title: Building the Bridge: What We Heard at the 2026 California AgTech Alliance Convening
summary: California does not lack promising ideas, agricultural expertise or technical talent. The challenge is connecting them. Here is what we heard at the 2026 Annual Convening.
alt: Convening participants work together with building blocks at a table during a facilitated activity.

title: What We Learned from Australia
summary: What the Alliance learned from an August delegation to Australia led by CDFA Secretary Karen Ross, and how a new California–Queensland partnership strengthens agricultural innovation at home.
alt: California delegation members and hosts beside a cultivated field during the visit to Kalfresh in Queensland.

title: Building California’s Statewide Front Door for Agricultural Innovation
summary: The California AgTech Alliance is connecting regional programs, people, and infrastructure so farmers, entrepreneurs, educators, students, and investors can find the right path forward.
alt: A tractor pulls a disc harrow across a dry field under a bright sky, raising dust.
